anya: CI red on PR #1234 — only the python-tests shard failed (test_db_lock flake). Anyone able to rerun just that shard? want to avoid rebuilding the docker image.
thomas: You can use the retry-shard bot: `/retry-shard 1234 --shard=python-tests --preserve-image` — preserves the built image and skips re-packing.
devops-bot: [automated] Queued retry request 987654321 for PR 1234 (shard=python-tests). I'll post when it starts.
olivia: If the bot isn't responding you can use GH API: `gh api -X POST /repos/redwood-inference/repo/actions/runs/987654321/rerun -f jobs=python-tests` (grab the run id from the workflow run page)
jen: Our internal tool also works: `cictl rerun --run 987654321 --only=python-tests --skip-image` — this keeps cached layers and avoids a full image rebuild.
thomas: Quick note — if you need to narrow flaky commits later: `cictl bisect --test test_db_lock --base=main --head=pr/1234 --shards=python-tests` (runs a minimal bisect across shards).
anya: Kicked the `retry-shard` command, bot replied success and job is starting on builder-7. will update.
